description: Turn a short video segment into an animated GIF with a generated color palette. Up to 32 MiB input/output and ten minutes of media. FFmpeg WebAssembly runs in a worker; small settings and clips work best on mobile. Automatic mode may use native FFmpeg in Kubernetes when the browser runs out of resources. GIF clips are limited to 15 seconds and 800 pixels wide. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: video_gif
title: Video to GIF
